A little more time at the table

Good food has a way of bringing us back to each other.

At Tamarind House, the kitchen follows the seasons and the memories carried in East African cooking. We grill over open flame, simmer slowly and serve generously.

Come as you are. Order for the middle of the table. Stay for the last cup of chai.

Our kind of hospitality

The best seat is the one you share.

Tamarind House takes its cues from the generosity of home cooking: bold ingredients, patient hands and food placed at the centre. Our menu shifts with the seasons, but the welcome is always the same.

Gather your people. We’ll take care of the rest.

Karibu. Stay a while.
